authoritative_sources.evidence: GitHub repo title: Open Science AI Tools for Systematic, Protocol-Based Literature Reviews.
README describes tools for systematic reviews: Screening, Download, Convert, Review; workflow Search -> Screen -> Download -> Convert -> Review; CLI, web initializer, and programming libraries.
Official documentation site from README and search result.
GNU Affero General Public License v3.
